points.evidence: Country profile section 'How much CO2 has the United States produced historically?': The United States has emitted 439 billion tonnes, as of 2025.
Country profile section 'How much CO2 has China produced historically?': China has emitted 298 billion tonnes, as of 2025.
Country profile section 'How much CO2 has the United Kingdom produced historically?': The United Kingdom has emitted 80.7 billion tonnes, as of 2025.
Country profile section 'How much CO2 has India produced historically?': India has emitted 69.2 billion tonnes, as of 2025.
Country profile section 'How much CO2 has Brazil produced historically?': Brazil has emitted 18.7 billion tonnes, as of 2025.
